g.title: Sheet.50
g.text: The network has 16384 IP addresses (64*256):from 172.16.128.0 to 172.16.191.255

g.title: Sheet.69

g.title: Sheet.70
g.text: Hence, the network has 16382 usable IPs(the pattern value*256 - 2)
